# cloudraya_template (Data Source)

Looks up a CloudRaya OS template by name, scoped to a region — templates are offered per region, so the same name can exist in one region and not another.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Templates are offered per region; the lookup fails at plan time if the
# template exists but is not active in region_id.
data "cloudraya_template" "ubuntu" {
  name      = "Ubuntu 22.04 v05.22"
  region_id = data.cloudraya_region.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Template name, for example `Ubuntu 22.04 v05.22`.
- `region_id` (String) Region the template must be active in.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project to query under. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Template identifier (ULID), usable as a `template_id`.
- `status_text` (String) Template status.
